definitions.gloss: early period, initial stage, beginning phase
definitions.explanation: The first or early phase of a process, era, illness, or development. Emphasizes the stage rather than the exact starting point.

examples.japanese: {初期|しょき}{設定|せってい}に{戻|もど}す。
{病気|びょうき}が{初期|しょき}の{段階|だんかい}で{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: The illness was discovered at an early stage.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトの{初期|しょき}{段階|だんかい}では{予算|よさん}の{見積|みつ}もりが{難|むずか}しかった。
examples.english: In the initial stages of the project, estimating the budget was difficult.

notes:
Compound of {初|しょ} (first, beginning) + {期|き} (period, stage). Used across many fields including medicine, technology, history, and project management.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初期|しょき}{段階|だんかい} (initial stage)
- {初期|しょき}{設定|せってい} (default settings, initial configuration)
- {初期|しょき}{症状|しょうじょう} (early symptoms)
- {初期|しょき}{費用|ひよう} (initial cost, startup cost)
- {初期|しょき}{不良|ふりょう} (initial defect)
- {初期|しょき}の{頃|ころ} (in the early days)
- {江戸|えど}{初期|しょき} (early Edo period)

USAGE:
In technology, {初期|しょき}{設定|せってい} (default/factory settings) and {初期|しょき}{化|か} (initialization) are extremely common terms. In medicine, {初期|しょき} often refers to the early stage of a disease when treatment is most effective.
